editorial.blurb: Carbon Live Fire channels the energy of a lively Mexican grill where wood-fired flavors meet a buzzing, upscale-casual atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the promotional Tuesday tacos if you want full toppings and quick service—order off the regular menu instead, and expect a wait during peak hours; the steak and barbacoa tacos with their red salsa are where the kitchen shines.
